literature_notes: Four ledger lines were evaluated. L1, L2, and L3 all describe the same MCAM-BirA*-HA construct, in which BirA* and HA are fused to the C-terminus of full-length MCAM. Per the authoritative topology landmarks, the C-terminus of MCAM (residues 581–646) is intracellular; this tag therefore faces the cytoplasm and cannot serve as an extracellular surface tag. The construct is well-validated (stable expression confirmed by Western blot in L2; correct membrane localisation confirmed by confocal imaging in L3), so it is recorded in other_positions. L4 describes full-length CD146 (MCAM) bearing either a FLAG or Myc tag used for co-immunoprecipitation, but no tag position is stated — no residue number, no loop name, and no terminus is identified. The rules explicitly disqualify constructs whose tag position is unstated. No ledger line reports a tolerated insertion at any extracellular position of MCAM; sites is therefore empty, which is the correct answer.

literature_other_positions.note: BirA*-HA fused to the C-terminus of full-length MCAM; the C-terminus (residues 581–646) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag is cytoplasmic, not extracellular. Construct confirmed expressed (L2) and correctly localised (L3).
